corrected_findings.issue: Six-z trial drop-in sorted before the current late r17 drop-ins; its candidate ExecStart would be overridden after the baseline stopped
corrected_findings.fix: Use one explicit 64-z owned prefix; require the new basename to sort after every original loaded drop-in before creating journal/drop-in, and retain that assertion on every action. Refuse other current-prefix or legacy six-z trial drop-ins. No other drop-in is removed.

corrected_findings.issue: Actual systemd249 omits empty ExecStop/ExecStopPost command arrays even with --all; blindly substituting empty values would hide a real hook
corrected_findings.fix: Use --all and permit only exactly these two missing keys. Require a second complete unfiltered show --all to contain no ExecStop-prefixed property and the identical other selected properties. Read the actual fragment and every loaded drop-in, rejecting any ExecStop/ExecStopPost assignment or legacy .include, then explicitly represent the proven empty hooks. Any other missing property remains refused.

corrected_findings.issue: Actual no-job property is empty while the original executor required literal zero
corrected_findings.fix: Accept only token arrays [] or ['0']; any nonzero job or additional token is refused.

corrected_findings.issue: A second partial restoration retained the prior restored PID record and could refuse to normally stop the actual new owner
corrected_findings.fix: After validating the new handoff and before durably entering a new STARTING/RESTORING attempt, clear only that attempt's stale owner/health record. Its predecessor provenance remains in the durable handoff.source. Partial-stop then binds and checks the actual new sole owner.

remaining_explicit_recovery_limits: A crash after durable stop_issued=true but before the systemctl stop request can leave observation pending without replaying stop. Root must audit and may explicitly request a normal stop of the exact same owner; no automatic resend was added in this narrow patch.
An ambiguous STARTING attempt with no owner is intentionally not blindly retried. No consumed marker may be cleared and no old checkpoint may be replayed.
Actual stop/checkpoint/candidate start/restored-owner validation are parent-owned and remain required; local fixtures are not hardware acceptance.
